resources.string: Allow the same fingerprints on different IDs

Off by default \u2014 a duplicate registration is what a registry should refuse. Turn on when one person\'s fingers must stand in for several test identities. Compares against templates held on this device only.
Save the fingerprints that authorise a transaction

Stored under verifications/, separate from registration templates, as evidence behind an approval. Declines are never stored. This keeps a biometric per transaction rather than per identity, so it grows without limit \u2014 leave off unless the audit trail is required.
Deletes that ID only: its templates and verification captures on this device, its Firebase Storage files and its user document. Nothing else in the project is touched.

This permanently deletes %1$s from this device and from Firebase \u2014 registration templates, verification captures, Storage files and the user document. It cannot be undone. Other IDs are not affected.
